first.rationale: The competitor’s entry pricing directly threatens the price-sensitive SMB segment, and prior evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing lifted both acquisition and revenue in that segment. Verify the pricing result and onboarding alternative before committing; promotion may attract lower-value or less-retentive accounts, so qualification and downstream value must be monitored.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and should help recover activation, while the verified prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. Promotional pricing is not sustainable: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline. Monitor qualified activation and retention to ensure reduced friction does not lower account quality.
